_readme: Terms that must not appear anywhere in the kit. Read tools/neutral-gate.mjs first.
`terms` are case-insensitive regex fragments. \\b is a word boundary — use it for
short or common words, or the gate will match inside longer innocent ones.
`allow` entries are exceptions, each with a `why`. An allowlist without reasons
is where violations go to hide, so a reason is required by convention even
though the tool will not enforce one.
Names go in tools/neutral-terms.local.json, not here. That file is gitignored
and read by the gate alongside this one, so a client's name, abbreviations,
products and people are checked on every run without the wordlist itself
being the one place in the repo that names them. Same shape: { "terms": [] }.
Forking for a new client: add their sector's words here and their names to the
local file. Keep the old entries too. A term costs nothing to leave in and
catches a copy-paste from the last engagement, which is the way most of these
